subject: it_gatling
sources: gold.mjs new --dry --concept 2026-10-10 (WF v10 S1 items-30; concept out/concept-items30 v1.png = refs/it_gatling.png); brief subjects/_items30; facts written 2026-10-10 from the brief AND the concept image (decided: front = the ring of six barrels (muzzle end); left flank = the flank the concept shows. DECISION vs the brief: the brief puts the sling loop and the round motor cover on the hidden right flank; the concept (chosen) draws both on the visible left flank, so facts follow the concept (left flank: lamp, vent slots, feed chute, motor cover, sling loop); the right flank is plain smooth panels.)
description: A fictional heavy rotary-barrel game prop for a mining crew, held level at the hip with the barrel cluster pointing forward. A boxy brick-red painted shell receiver with large chamfers. At its front a ring of six dark steel round barrels (a cluster about half the total length) held by two round dark steel clamp plates, one at the muzzle end and one in the middle of the cluster. On top of the receiver a charcoal arched carry handle running front to back. Under the front of the receiver a charcoal vertical handle with three ribs. At the rear a diagonal-ribbed charcoal pistol grip raked backward and a short thick charcoal padded brace tube ending in a flat charcoal shoulder pad. A square brick-red ammunition box hangs under the receiver behind the front handle, with a short curved charcoal feed chute running from its top up into the receiver's left side. Two short slotted vents and one tiny teal lamp window on the left flank of the receiver; behind them a round raised brick-red motor cover and a charcoal sling loop on the left flank near the rear.
proportions: About 1.10 m long (front to back), 0.22 m wide and 0.36 m tall. (length : width : height = 5.00 : 1 : 1.64)
sides: everything listed as on the left flank is on the left only: the two slotted vents, the tiny teal lamp window, the curved feed chute, the round motor cover and the sling loop. The right flank is plain: smooth brick-red panels with no lamp, no cover and no loop. The carry handle, the front handle, the ammunition box, the pistol grip and the barrel ring are on the centre line.
